rules.title: Access another user's object by ID
rules.description: Attempt to access/modify a resource belonging to another user by changing the path/query ID while authenticated as a different user. Expect 403/404, never the other user's data.

rules.title: Expired or malformed token
rules.description: Send an expired, tampered, or malformed auth token. Expect 401 Unauthorized.

rules.owasp: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
rules.title: Mass assignment of restricted fields
rules.description: Include extra/restricted fields (e.g. role, isAdmin) in a create/update payload that the client should not be able to set. Verify they are ignored or rejected, not silently applied.

rules.title: Excessive pagination / payload size
rules.description: Request an extremely large page size or oversized request body. Expect the API to cap/reject rather than degrade or crash.

rules.title: Access admin-only endpoint as regular user
rules.description: Call an admin/privileged endpoint using a regular user's credentials. Expect 403 Forbidden.

rules.title: SSRF via user-supplied URL
rules.description: If the endpoint accepts a URL (e.g. webhook, avatar fetch), supply an internal/loopback address and verify the server does not fetch it.

rules.title: Verbose error messages
rules.description: Trigger a server error (e.g. invalid input) and verify the response does not leak stack traces, internal paths, or framework versions.

rules.title: Injection via headers
rules.description: Submit script/command injection payloads (e.g. XSS, CRLF injection) in header values. Verify they are rejected or sanitized, not reflected unescaped.

rules.title: Classic SQL injection strings
rules.description: Submit payloads such as "' OR '1'='1", "'; DROP TABLE users; --" in string fields/parameters. Expect safe rejection, never a 500 error or unexpected data exposure.

rules.title: Rate limit enforcement
rules.description: Burst requests beyond documented rate limits. Expect 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header where documented.

rules.owasp: API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
rules.title: Automated bulk creation abuse
rules.description: Rapidly issue many creation requests in a short window (e.g. account signups, coupon redemptions). Expect rate limiting or CAPTCHA-style friction, not unlimited automation.

rules.title: Verbose stack trace on server error
rules.description: Trigger an unhandled server error (e.g. malformed input causing a 500). Verify the response does not leak stack traces, internal paths, or framework versions.

rules.title: Deprecated/legacy API version still reachable
rules.description: Probe for old API versions (e.g. /v1/ when /v2/ is current). Verify deprecated versions are disabled or have equivalent security controls.

rules.title: Overly permissive CORS policy
rules.description: Send a request with an arbitrary Origin header. Verify Access-Control-Allow-Origin is not '*' combined with credentials, and only trusted origins are reflected.

rules.title: JWT 'alg: none' acceptance
rules.description: Send a JWT with its algorithm header set to 'none' and signature stripped. Expect the token to be rejected as invalid/unauthenticated.

rules.title: Access another user's object by ID
rules.description: Authenticated as User A, request an object belonging to User B by changing the path/query identifier. Expect 403/404, never User B's data.

rules.title: Expired or malformed token rejected
rules.description: Send an expired, tampered, or malformed authentication token. Expect 401 Unauthorized, not a 500 error or silent acceptance.

rules.owasp: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
rules.title: Mass assignment of restricted fields
rules.description: Include restricted/admin-only fields (e.g. role, isAdmin, balance) in a create/update payload as a regular user. Verify they are ignored or rejected, not silently applied.

rules.title: Excessive payload/pagination size
rules.description: Request an extremely large page size, or send an oversized request body/array. Expect the API to cap or reject the request rather than degrade or crash.

rules.title: Access admin-only endpoint as regular user
rules.description: Call an administrative/privileged endpoint using a regular authenticated user's credentials. Expect 403 Forbidden.

rules.owasp: API6:2023 Unrestricted Access to Sensitive Business Flows
rules.title: Automated abuse of sensitive flows
rules.description: Rapidly repeat a sensitive business action (signup, coupon redemption, purchase) in an automated fashion. Expect rate limiting or additional friction, not unlimited automation.

rules.title: SSRF via user-supplied URL
rules.description: Supply an internal/loopback/metadata-service URL (e.g. http://169.254.169.254, http://localhost) in any field the server fetches or redirects to. Verify the server refuses to fetch internal/private addresses.

rules.title: Verbose error messages leak internals
rules.description: Trigger an unhandled server error with malformed input. Verify the response does not leak stack traces, internal file paths, or framework/version details.

rules.title: Deprecated API version still reachable
rules.description: Probe for older/deprecated API versions (e.g. /v1/ when /v2/ is current). Verify deprecated versions are disabled or have equivalent security controls.

rules.title: Unsanitized data from third-party integration
rules.description: If the API consumes data from an upstream/third-party API, verify that data (e.g. HTML, script content, oversized fields) is sanitized/validated before being stored or rendered, not trusted blindly.

rules.title: Classic SQL/NoSQL injection payloads
rules.description: Submit payloads such as "' OR '1'='1", "'; DROP TABLE users; --", or NoSQL operator injection (e.g. {"$ne": null}) in string fields/parameters. Expect safe rejection or sanitization, never a 500 error or data exposure.
